setup: Record PCB manifest SHA, unit UUID, firmware SHA, MCU/LED lots
acceptance: Trace measurements to exact CAD and populated BOM

setup: Unpowered: check C1/C3 GND, U1 GND and every edge GND contact
acceptance: Continuous low resistance without a repair jumper

setup: Inspect polarity, chip pin 1, USB slots/lands, solder joints and shorts
acceptance: Matches assembly drawings and head/follower BOM

setup: Observe MCU 3.3 V and regulator output at startup and load changes
acceptance: Stable regulation within applicable regulator/MCU limits; no resets or oscillation

setup: Qualify C8/C9 at operating bias and temperature
acceptance: At least 1 uF effective each; regulator stable across intended loads

setup: Walk every pixel and row/column using known test patterns
acceptance: All 64 pixels map correctly and no unintended pixels light

setup: Scope column selection and blanking
acceptance: 2 kHz scan and 250 Hz full-frame refresh; anodes blank during column transitions

setup: Display blank/full/checkerboard/held frames and scroll
acceptance: Stable refresh with no visible ghosting or frozen scan

setup: Measure peak LED current including a held selected column
acceptance: Below exact LED continuous-current limit; consistent with 1.2k row-current bound

setup: Measure HCT244 supply current across worst intended patterns
acceptance: Below datasheet package rating with justified operating margin including input/dynamic current

setup: Measure drivers/regulator/head at intended ambient and supply extremes
acceptance: All component and mechanical material temperatures within ratings with margin

setup: Test both USB-C cable orientations
acceptance: Starts and runs from intended regulated 5 V charger in both orientations

setup: Scope input current and rails during repeated connection
acceptance: No charger trip or sustained overcurrent; stable startup

setup: Use controlled electronic load and verify limiting
acceptance: Consistent with TPS2553 equations for installed 33k resistor and documented tolerances

setup: Controlled output short then removal
acceptance: Limits/recovers according to datasheet without damage; record peak/steady current and temperature

setup: 3.3 V-compatible PC adapter with common ground and board's own power
acceptance: Error-free prepared 115200 baud exchanges over a sustained documented run

setup: Verify each physical link and directional propagation
acceptance: TX feeds next RX; physical order and intended protocol demonstrated

setup: Controller/target demo; head-only JP1/JP2 closed
acceptance: Addressed exchanges and replies work at 100 kHz

setup: Scope SDA/SCL on the intended full chain
acceptance: Rise time at most 1 us at 100 kHz; VOL and VIH meet connected-device limits

setup: Measure head input and each tile rail under worst intended full-chain pattern
acceptance: Every HCT rail at least 4.5 V; normal chain current below minimum head limiting threshold

setup: Fit diffuser and bridge tiles on a backing structure
acceptance: LED clearance/registration correct; USB insertion and bending loads bypass solder bridges

setup: Read selected caption with fitted diffuser under intended viewing conditions
acceptance: Readable at documented distance and ambient lighting accepted for the intended application

setup: Record supply/cable requirements maximum qualified tile count temperature and brightness
acceptance: Explicit supported conditions match qualification evidence

setup: Review final Gerbers drill process BOM CPL orientation and actual supplier preview
acceptance: Factory process accepted and inspection/test procedure reproducible

setup: Review raw evidence for every applicable test
acceptance: All required checks passed on physical v4 hardware; no unexplained deviations

setup: Fit optional PicoBlade and verify pin continuity and probe adapter wiring
acceptance: REF SWIO GND correct; probe power outputs disconnected; generic pigtail mating verified

setup: Inspect connector insertion pin protrusion and solder hole fill on actual 1.6 mm PCB
acceptance: Document fit and acceptable solder joints with the prototype 0.6 mm holes

setup: Fit grid face bezel and carrier with top hooks and M2 screws
acceptance: Walls seat on PCB without LED contact; no cracks loose fasteners or light plenum

setup: Join 4+1 carrier sections with splice plates; test cable insertion and intended handling
acceptance: Boards stay aligned and insertion/bending loads bypass electrical wire bridges

setup: Unpowered: check TP1–TP10 against their documented pins/nets
acceptance: Every pad maps correctly; no shorts to neighbours
notes: Copper pads add no fitted component

setup: Insert 0.5 mm tinned wire in ordinary 0.8 mm PTH holes
acceptance: Easy insertion and sound solder fill; no damaged annuli
notes: Test matched contact numbers; retain backing support

setup: Clip front wire ends and fit printed grid over solder
acceptance: Within 0.5 mm protrusion / 0.6 mm solder height; grid seats with no cell leakage
notes: Closed 0.4 mm solder-hood walls/roof; nominal CAD does not qualify print/solder tolerances

setup: Fit carrier then reach all ten rear test pads and edge contacts
acceptance: Probe tip and ground pigtail can reach without loading soldered joints
notes: Rear carrier supports the mechanical chain

setup: Scope bothU4inputs withshortstaplechain andchosen3.3VTTLadapter
acceptance: Monotonic rising/falling transitions<=10ns/V, especially0.8–2.0V; record actualleads andmargin

setup: IdentifynewMCU andread/recordPD7/NRST configuration beforematrixwalk
acceptance: CorrectGPIOavailability for8rows; no unauthorizedoption-bytechanges

setup: InspectGCTshellslot/component-side soldering on1.6mmboard
acceptance: Reliable barrelfill/retention with0.95mmstakes andactualUSBplug
